meta.title: Improve SortedSet union
meta.body_summary: Optimize SortedSet.union by tracking subtree sizes during tree copy/merge to avoid O(n) size recalculations.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit optimization of SortedSet.union via size-tracking; no benchmark; closed without human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 40 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit. It is a targeted data-structure optimization, but it was closed without merge, likely due to lack of human review and evidence.

review_details.performance_claim: Improve SortedSet union by avoiding re-counting elements via tracking size during tree copy/merge.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without human review or merge; only bot comments offered non-blocking suggestions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-friction data structure optimization in core library; closed without human review suggests process boundary where AI-authored PRs may not receive attention unless accompanied by benchmarks or active maintainer engagement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or performance evidence provided; only narrative description of optimization.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression handling as PR was closed.

core_change_summary.description: In sorted_set/set.mbt, the union function was modified to use a copy_tree_with_size helper that returns the node and its subtree size, and the merge function accumulates sizes to avoid calling size() which would recursively count elements.
change_trajectory: Single commit added copy_tree_with_size function and updated merge logic to track sizes during tree copy/merge.

review_signals.summary: Bot suggested using the size info from copy_tree_with_size and noted potential overflow and missing docs.
Coveralls reported 100% coverage of changed/added lines, overall coverage increased.
